observations: The authoritative current VCS run parsed the exact-board source set but failed during common elaboration with Error-[XMRE]. Simulation.status is not_run, no progress event was flushed, and no current runtime frontier exists.

The six earliest concrete failures are generated testbench assignments to mlp_gate_io_in_bits_data__bore, mlp_up_io_in_bits_data__bore, mlp_gate_io_out_bits_data__bore, mlp_up_io_out_bits_data__bore, mlp_mul_io_out_bits_data__bore, and mlp_down_io_out_bits_data__bore at current_dag_boundary_payload indices 6 through 11.

The current SACG/CCTG causal slice states not_applicable_before_runtime_execution and requires use of the earliest real tool error. Consequently, the previously materialized kernel_start_precedes_stage0_input and zero-output records are planning history only for this source attempt and cannot authorize a DUT or lower-layer repair.

The exact user sample wrapper identity currently passes: exact_user_sample_wrapper=true, simulation_hashes_match_source=true, compute-slot ABI and timing facts are bound, and the selected sample-project source closure is identified. Those user-supplied sources are not the failed owner and must remain unchanged.

Operator-leaf and single-transformer-layer gates are certified. The completed direct connected-kernel replay observed accepted start/ingress, all 1792 ingress beats, all 1792 egress beats, terminal last, and passing boundary liveness. The current board evidence contains no qualifying contradiction to those invariants, and there is no open current-scope backtrack request.

The legal repair owner is the generated exact-board testbench/observer generator and its verification metadata. Adding the missing bore nets to synthesizable DUT RTL, altering the connected kernel, or replacing the exact wrapper would exceed the localized repair boundary.

The observability repair must bind each payload probe to an equivalent declaration proven in the current compiled source closure. Tying probes to constants, deleting required current-DAG coverage, or guessing similarly named nets would make compilation easier by weakening the checker and is not legal.

The semantic expected output remains target-model inference with expected_output_sha256 92fc53de80c8caca6ea04cc69ab768a1f6db0e55a2ab0ebbd9ac0adc6e3c85b4. No numeric comparison has run for the board because simulation did not execute; no tolerance change is authorized.

Static board weight information lists twelve consumed hashes for the immutable one-layer validation scope, but current dynamic loader-consumption proof is absent because VCS did not execute. Disk manifests alone therefore do not establish board consumption.

case_multilayer_functional, case_pipeline_deadlock_check, case_axi_protocol_check, case_ddr_image_roundtrip, and case_board_semantic_evidence are dependency-blocked evidence gaps, not earlier root causes. They must remain unexecuted until the repaired functional_sim gate passes.

The case_deadlock_axi_check token findings are downstream of the failed simulation and include literal legacy-style interface/testbench token expectations that conflict with already passed exact-board interface discovery. If they persist after a successful current VCS run, they require a bounded checker/case-adapter review rather than an assumed hardware-port rewrite.

sacg_memory_truth reports 24 active current-scope contamination barriers and eight open retry requests: retry_request.0136, retry_request.0140, retry_request.0141, retry_request.0142, retry_request.0143, retry_request.0144, retry_request.0145, and retry_request.0146. These block downstream consumption and promotion, but do not prohibit the bounded current-stage repair. They remain active until fresh Stage7 board evidence passes and is promoted.
proposed_actions: Reconcile the six failing current_dag_boundary_payload XMRs against the hash-bound compiled RTL declarations, patch only the responsible generated observer template and generated exact-board testbench, and emit a per-probe evidence map.

Repair the observability metadata in the same bounded change so its schema is valid, its implementation is demonstrably simulation/testbench only, and it declares current-DAG boundary observation without changing elastic pipeline semantics.

Recompute generated-testbench and simulator source-set hashes while attesting that exact sample-project wrapper hashes, checkpoint, stimulus, golden, numeric policy, semantic testbench contract, and weight-binding requirements are unchanged.

Rerun only case_vcs_functional_sim and case_vcs_evidence_analyzer first. If compilation succeeds but runtime fails, use the new execution fingerprint and fresh CCTG frontier for the next board-level repair decision.
Only after functional_sim passes, execute the remaining board-layer gates in dependency order and assemble board semantic evidence. Do not invoke any backend or board-runtime tool.
After all current board gates pass, reconcile the eight retry requests and 24 contamination barriers using the fresh promoted Stage7 evidence; otherwise leave them active.
risks: Implementation/board risk: changing the exact sample wrapper, compute-slot ABI, timing contract, or DUT RTL to satisfy testbench XMRs would contaminate the validated design boundary and invalidate source identity.
Verification risk: removing or tying off the six payload observations could permit elaboration while silently defeating current-DAG data-order and pipeline-boundary evidence.

Artifact-identity risk: changing the generated testbench changes its source hash and simulator compile fingerprint. Reusing the old board simulation manifest, executed manifest, diagnosis applicability binding, or runtime trace after the patch would be invalid.

Lower-layer contamination risk: the current run supplies no direct contradiction to certified connected-kernel invariants. Replaying or modifying leaf/kernel scopes would violate the hierarchical repair loop.

Pipeline risk: regenerated monitors could incorrectly require all unequal-latency stages to be active in the same cycle. They must preserve certified elastic order and required different-token overlap instead.

Model/shape/numeric risk: changing checkpoint, 16-token stimulus, 1792-beat shape expectation, target-model golden, numeric policy, tolerance, or semantic comparison boundary would mask rather than repair the harness failure.

Memory/runtime risk: AXI counts, address mapping, DDR roundtrip, runtime load order, and complete required weight consumption remain unproven until real simulation executes; independent AXI or prefetch activity cannot substitute for output/lifecycle-frontier progress.
Scope risk: expanding the golden or weight coverage to embeddings, tokenization, final norm, LM head/logits, or sampling would violate the Transformer-block-only accelerator boundary.

Checker risk: treating the current case_deadlock_axi_check literal-token report as proof that the exact wrapper lacks AXI would encourage hardcoded port substitutions. Fresh elaborated hierarchy and protocol evidence must decide that issue.

Promotion risk: active SACG contamination barriers and retry requests prohibit synthesis/backend/board-runtime consumption even after a local compile fix; full current-layer Stage7 closure is still required.
